historical_genesis.definition: commercial-era Genesis, community reconstruction (build-identical rebuild; boundaries by the reconstruction authors)

modern_sgdk.definition: modern SGDK/GCC homebrew (author builds; GCC-listing / re-assembly truth)

xplat_modern.definition: cross-platform M68K, modern toolchain or modern authored source

xplat_period.definition: cross-platform M68K, period toolchain or period source

BattleIsleEditor.evidence: Amiga; the author's 1991 source, A68K 2.71 + vlink, executables byte-identical

D01.evidence: Sonic 1/2/S&K (1991-94) + 36 Sonic CD (1993) modules; Sega hand assembly; AS / asl rebuilds, listing semantics

D02.evidence: Flicky (Genesis 1991); Sega hand assembly; AS asl rebuild

D03.evidence: Shining Force I/II (1992/93); SN 68k 2.53 rebuild; data split of the authorized image by the reconstruction authors
D03.note: boundaries from a community data split

D04.evidence: Phantasy Star II (1989); AS Bld 89 rebuild

EmuTOS.evidence: Atari ST/Amiga firmware reimplementation; GCC 4.6.4 + gas; reproducibility observed, not pinned

amiga-realtime3d.evidence: Amiga programs, vasm, CC BY-SA 4.0 repository

toslibc.evidence: Atari ST C library and examples, m68k-elf GCC 13.3

scope_note: Genesis rows are out-of-fold (strict leave-one-lineage-out, SEG-084 A0 = SEG-076 model A, bitwise); cross-platform rows are transfer scores of the all-Genesis model A and are never out-of-fold; no row is a held-out independent evaluation (those are SEG-085-T002/T004)
